meaning.en: To have a reputation that has spread beyond one's own circle.

equivalents: with a reputation that precedes one

examples.zh: 这家老字号早已名声在外。
examples.en: This old brand has long been famous far and wide.

examples.zh: 他在业内名声在外，不少公司想挖他。
examples.en: He has a big name in the industry and many firms want to poach him.

examples.zh: 景德镇的瓷器名声在外。
examples.en: Jingdezhen porcelain is renowned everywhere.

usage.en: Predicate; can be neutral or, for a bad reputation, negative.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也可指坏名声。

meaning.en: To keep exclaiming in amazement or admiration.

examples.zh: 游客们对壮丽的瀑布惊叹不已。
examples.en: The tourists marvelled at the magnificent waterfall.

examples.zh: 他的演奏让全场观众惊叹不已。
examples.en: His playing left the whole audience in awe.

examples.zh: 我们对这座城市的发展速度惊叹不已。
examples.en: We were amazed at the speed of the city's development.

usage.en: Predicate, usually with 对…….
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用“对……惊叹不已”。

meaning.en: Something never seen before.

examples.zh: 这种新材料的性能是前所未见的。
examples.en: The performance of this new material is unlike anything seen before.

examples.zh: 展会上出现了前所未见的技术。
examples.en: Technology never seen before appeared at the exhibition.

examples.zh: 这场大雪是当地前所未见的。
examples.en: This snowfall was unlike anything the locals had seen.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; close to 前所未有 but about what has been seen.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，与“前所未有”相近，侧重“见”。

meaning.en: Extremely old and worn out.
meaning.zh: 又破又旧，已经到了无法忍受的地步。

examples.zh: 那间破旧不堪的老屋终于被拆了。
examples.en: The dilapidated old house was finally torn down.

examples.zh: 他穿着一件破旧不堪的外套。
examples.en: He wore a threadbare coat.

examples.zh: 教室里的桌椅破旧不堪，需要更换。
examples.en: The classroom desks and chairs are worn out and need replacing.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To have nothing to say in reply.

examples.zh: 面对他的质问，我无言以对。
examples.en: Faced with his questioning, I had no reply.

examples.zh: 对方列出了确凿证据，被告无言以对。
examples.en: The other side presented solid evidence and the defendant was left speechless.

examples.zh: 孩子的问题让妈妈一时无言以对。
examples.en: The child's question left Mum momentarily lost for words.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: To reform oneself and start life afresh.
meaning.zh: 改正错误，重新开始过正派的生活。

examples.zh: 出狱后，他决心重新做人。
examples.en: After his release he resolved to turn over a new leaf.

examples.zh: 给孩子一个重新做人的机会。
examples.en: Give the child a chance to start afresh.

examples.zh: 经历这场教训，他发誓要重新做人。
examples.en: After this hard lesson he swore to start over as a better person.

usage.en: Predicate; often with 决心/发誓.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“决心、发誓”搭配。

meaning.en: To run away secretly out of fear of being punished for a crime.
meaning.zh: 犯了罪，害怕受到惩罚而偷偷逃走。

examples.zh: 嫌疑人畏罪潜逃，警方已发出通缉令。
examples.en: The suspect has fled and the police have issued a wanted notice.

examples.zh: 他挪用公款后畏罪潜逃。
examples.en: After embezzling public funds he absconded for fear of punishment.

examples.zh: 经理畏罪潜逃，公司账目一片混乱。
examples.en: The manager fled out of fear of the law and the company's accounts were in chaos.

usage.en: Predicate; legal and news register.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于法律、新闻语体。

meaning.en: To go by a roundabout route; to avoid something by going another way.

examples.zh: 前方修路，我们只好绕道而行。
examples.en: The road ahead is being repaired, so we had to take a detour.

examples.zh: 看到那条狗，他绕道而行。
examples.en: Seeing the dog, he went round another way.

examples.zh: 遇到难题别绕道而行，要正面解决。
examples.en: Don't dodge difficulties; face them head on.

usage.en: Predicate; also figurative for avoiding trouble.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也可比喻回避问题。

meaning.en: To catch the criminal together with the stolen goods.
meaning.zh: 罪犯和赃物一起被抓获。

examples.zh: 小偷被民警当场人赃俱获。
examples.en: The thief was caught red-handed by the police.

examples.zh: 警方在车站将嫌疑人人赃俱获。
examples.en: The police caught the suspect with the loot at the station.

examples.zh: 他行窃时被人赃俱获，无从抵赖。
examples.en: He was caught in the act with the goods and could not deny it.

usage.en: Predicate; police reports. 人赃并获 is a common alternative.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于警方通报，也作“人赃并获”。

meaning.en: Impossible to resist or oppose.

examples.zh: 时代的潮流是不可抗拒的。
examples.en: The tide of the times cannot be resisted.

examples.zh: 地震是不可抗拒的自然灾害。
examples.en: An earthquake is a natural disaster no one can resist.

examples.zh: 她的魅力有一种不可抗拒的力量。
examples.en: Her charm has an irresistible pull.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; 不可抗拒的 + noun.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语。

meaning.en: To become skilled through self-teaching, without formal training.
meaning.zh: 没有老师系统教授，靠自己学习而成为有用的人才。

examples.zh: 他没上过大学，却自学成才，成了程序员。
examples.en: He never went to university, yet taught himself to become a programmer.

examples.zh: 这位自学成才的画家举办了个人画展。
examples.en: This self-taught painter held a solo exhibition.

examples.zh: 爷爷靠自学成才，修好了全村的收音机。
examples.en: Grandpa taught himself and fixed every radio in the village.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Too high or too good for others to reach.

examples.zh: 他的球技让对手难以企及。
examples.en: His football skill is out of his opponents' reach.

examples.zh: 这位大师的成就，后人难以企及。
examples.en: The master's achievements are beyond what later generations can match.

examples.zh: 房价高得让年轻人难以企及。
examples.en: House prices are beyond the reach of young people.

usage.en: Predicate or complement.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。

meaning.en: To be totally unaware of something.

examples.zh: 他沉浸在游戏中，浑然不觉天已经黑了。
examples.en: Absorbed in the game, he did not notice it had got dark.

examples.zh: 她对身边的危险浑然不觉。
examples.en: She was oblivious to the danger around her.

examples.zh: 大家都在背后议论，他却浑然不觉。
examples.en: Everyone was talking behind his back, but he was completely unaware.

usage.en: Predicate; often follows a clause describing what absorbs the person.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，前面常有说明原因的分句。

meaning.en: Something without a foundation, and so unable to last.
meaning.zh: 没有源头的水，比喻没有根基、不能长久的事物。

examples.zh: 脱离实践的理论是无源之水。
examples.en: Theory divorced from practice is water without a source.

examples.zh: 没有基础研究，技术创新就成了无源之水。
examples.en: Without basic research, technological innovation is a stream without a spring.

examples.zh: 这种说法是无源之水，经不起推敲。
examples.en: The claim has no basis and won't stand scrutiny.

usage.en: Often paired with 无本之木.
usage.zh: 常与“无本之木”并用。

meaning.en: Too shameful or improper to be seen by others.
meaning.zh: 事情不光彩，怕被别人知道或看见。

examples.zh: 他做的是见不得人的勾当。
examples.en: He is up to something shady.

examples.zh: 有什么见不得人的事吗？干吗躲着我？
examples.en: Is there something to hide? Why are you avoiding me?

examples.zh: 她觉得自己的出身见不得人，从不提起。
examples.en: She felt her background was something to be ashamed of and never mentioned it.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，口语色彩。

meaning.en: To share both glory and shame, standing together through good and bad.
meaning.zh: 共同享受荣誉，共同承担耻辱，形容关系密切、利害一致。

equivalents: share the good and the bad

examples.zh: 我们与公司荣辱与共。
examples.en: We stand by the company through thick and thin.

examples.zh: 他们是荣辱与共的战友。
examples.en: They are comrades who share both glory and disgrace.

examples.zh: 夫妻荣辱与共，才能走得长远。
examples.en: A couple who share the highs and lows will go the distance.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Coarse, vulgar tastes or content.

examples.zh: 这部综艺充满低级趣味。
examples.en: This variety show is full of vulgar humour.

examples.zh: 别用低级趣味的玩笑来博取笑声。
examples.en: Don't go for cheap laughs with crude jokes.

examples.zh: 他对低级趣味的东西毫无兴趣。
examples.en: He has no interest in anything vulgar.

usage.en: Noun phrase; often 带有低级趣味.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，常说“带有低级趣味”。

meaning.en: To know something perfectly by heart.

examples.zh: 这首诗他早已烂熟于心。
examples.en: He has long known this poem by heart.

examples.zh: 老厨师对每道菜的做法烂熟于心。
examples.en: The old chef knows the method for every dish by heart.

examples.zh: 考前把公式烂熟于心，答题才不慌。
examples.en: Know the formulas inside out before the exam so you won't panic.

usage.en: Predicate or complement.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。

meaning.en: To agree readily, without any hesitation.

examples.zh: 听说要帮忙，他满口答应。
examples.en: On hearing that help was needed, he readily agreed.

examples.zh: 老板满口答应加薪，结果一直没兑现。
examples.en: The boss readily promised a raise but never delivered.

examples.zh: 她满口答应来参加婚礼。
examples.en: She gladly agreed to attend the wedding.

usage.en: Predicate; sometimes hints the promise may not be kept.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，有时暗示未必兑现。

meaning.en: To rise and fall sharply and violently, as prices do.
meaning.zh: 价格或数量急剧上涨又急剧下跌。

examples.zh: 股市暴涨暴跌，投资者忧心忡忡。
examples.en: The stock market swung wildly and investors were worried.

examples.zh: 粮价暴涨暴跌，农民很难安排生产。
examples.en: With grain prices soaring and plunging, farmers struggle to plan production.

examples.zh: 比特币暴涨暴跌，风险很大。
examples.en: Bitcoin soars and plunges; it is very risky.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; markets and prices.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多用于行情、价格。

meaning.en: To lose ground steadily and keep falling back.

examples.zh: 敌军节节败退，退到了河对岸。
examples.en: The enemy kept falling back until they were across the river.

examples.zh: 我们的球队节节败退，被对手连扳三球。
examples.en: Our team was pushed back and the opponents pulled three goals back.

examples.zh: 传统书店在网购冲击下节节败退。
examples.en: Traditional bookshops have been losing ground to online shopping.

usage.en: Predicate; war and competition.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于战争、竞争。

meaning.en: To summon up all one's energy and enthusiasm.

examples.zh: 大家鼓足干劲，要在月底前完成任务。
examples.en: Everyone is going all out to finish by the end of the month.

examples.zh: 队员们鼓足干劲准备决赛。
examples.en: The team is fired up for the final.

examples.zh: 鼓足干劲，力争上游。
examples.en: Summon your energy and strive to be the best.

usage.en: Predicate; common in slogans. Often 鼓足干劲，力争上游.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于口号，常说“鼓足干劲，力争上游”。

meaning.en: To be anxious, irritable and unable to settle.
meaning.zh: 心里着急烦躁，无法安定。

examples.zh: 等待结果的那几天，他焦躁不安。
examples.en: During the days of waiting for the results he was on edge.

examples.zh: 狗焦躁不安地在门口转来转去。
examples.en: The dog paced restlessly by the door.

examples.zh: 天气闷热让人焦躁不安。
examples.en: The sultry weather made people irritable.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial with 地.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，或带“地”作状语。

natural: let the cat out of the bag

meaning.en: To let slip a clue that exposes the truth one is trying to hide.
meaning.zh: 不小心暴露了真相或隐藏的意图。

examples.zh: 骗子说着说着就露出马脚。
examples.en: As he talked, the fraudster gave himself away.

examples.zh: 他撒了个谎，结果很快露出马脚。
examples.en: He told a lie and was soon found out.

examples.zh: 别急，他迟早会露出马脚的。
examples.en: Don't worry; he will give himself away sooner or later.

usage.en: Predicate; also 露马脚.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也说“露马脚”。
